instructions.title: Get it ready
instructions.body: Turn the TV on, and have it on the same network. When pairing starts it shows a PIN on the screen: have the remote nearby to dismiss it if you stop.

schema.help: The TV shows a PIN when pairing starts: type it here. Pairing is kept, and the TV lists it under Settings › Remotes and Devices, where it can be removed.

port.title: Port
port.description: Where the TV answers. Found with it: change it only if it said otherwise.

actions.label: Pair with the TV
actions.description: The TV shows a PIN, which is asked for next. Once, for as long as the TV keeps the pairing.
